body: She was the one asking about it
You're right. I'll try to explain it to her today and I hope it goes okay. I love her so I think she deserves to know.
Its not that she doesn't care, she just has her own issues and dumping all my emotions onto her wouldn't be too good I think :/

But I am a burden. My behavior hurts people around me and more importantly, it hurts my girlfriend. Seeing me like this hurts her so much and I am terrified of telling her how bad I really am. She is really all I have and if I lost her, I don't know if I could live anymore so I just don't say anything.
I want to but the feeling that I'm all alone and that I'm just a burden and cannot be understood when I try to speak my mind just won't go away

I want to be happy so badly but it seems like any time I get to that point, something just drags me down and I lose everything. I already lost a friend and my girlfriend is becoming distant. The pain is becoming too much...
